title: Recognizing a colimit by constructible-source tests
statement: Let X be qcqs, Lambda a finite commutative ring, and F a module sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let A be small filtered, D a diagram of module sheaves, and iota a cocone to F [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose every map from a constructible G [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] to F factors through iota_a, and any two maps G -> D_a, G -> D_b with equal composites to F become equal after a common refinement in A. Then this given cocone is colimiting. Diagram objects need not be constructible.

source.place: Tags 09Z4 (lemma-constructible-is-compact), 03SA(3), 03EW(3); categorical recognition argument in Lean docstring

proof.text: Form L = colim D and its comparison t:L -> F. Finite presentation of every constructible G identifies Hom(G,L) with colim Hom(G,D_a). Factorization and refinement are respectively surjectivity and injectivity of Hom(G,t), by the equality criterion for filtered colimits of sets.

source.place: Tags 03SA(3), 095N, 03RZ, 09Z4; see the Lean docstring for the categorical argument

proof.text: Constructible generation implies these G separate morphisms. Injectivity makes t monic. Surjectivity lets every summand of the generating epimorphism onto F lift to L, so that epimorphism factors through t; thus t is epic.

source.place: Tags 03SA(3), 095N, 03RZ, 09Z4; see the Lean docstring for the categorical argument

proof.text: The module-sheaf category is abelian, so the monic and epic comparison is an isomorphism. Transport the existing colimit cocone along it; its legs become exactly iota.

theorem exists_constructible_colimit_cocone
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    (D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F)
    (hfactor : ∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ p : G ⟶ F,
        ∃ (a : A) (q : G ⟶ D.obj a), q ≫ ι.app a = p)
    (hrelations : ∀ (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G → ∀ (a b : A)
        (p : G ⟶ D.obj a) (q : G ⟶ D.obj b),
        p ≫ ι.app a = q ≫ ι.app b →
        ∃ (c : A) (f : a ⟶ c) (g : b ⟶ c), p ≫ D.map f = q ≫ D.map g) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι))
